description: PROPOSED process-evidence rules of Indy Init Rehearsal 9, drafted by an agent from the Rehearsal 6 rules (kickoff/rehearsal-006/process-evidence-rules.json): who may act, who the owner is, who reviews independently, which execution roles are review roles, and which owner decisions prove each owner obligation. requirements-compiler verify-process judges every record-bound obligation against these rules. They take effect only when the owner confirms them and pins their SHA-256 in kickoff/rehearsal-009/toolchain.lock.json (processEvidence.rulesSha256); until then the record gate fails closed. Agents never pin them.
